look_here_first: Look at spacing along the spike: flowers and broad bracts are visibly separated along a long slender, often nodding or drooping rachis rather than packed into a dense head.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: narrow linear to narrowly oblong gland-dotted leaflets

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: long slender terminal spike with visibly separated flowers and bracts

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: broad conspicuous bracts along an obvious rachis

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: nine stamens as a technical confirmation

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Herbaceous perennial with one to a few stems, branching above.

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Odd-pinnate; narrow linear to narrowly oblong leaflets, gland-dotted beneath.

key_traits.label: Inflorescence
key_traits.text: Long slender loose terminal spike, often nodding/drooping.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Sessile or nearly sessile flowers visibly spaced along rachis.

key_traits.label: Reproductive detail
key_traits.text: Nine stamens provide a technical confirmation.
